d: We are seeking an experienced, highly organized Warehouse Manager to oversee warehouse operations for a reputable fashion retail company in Kuwait.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in warehouse operations, inventory management, stock distribution, and team management, preferably within the fashion or retail industry. The role will be responsible for ensuring efficient warehouse operations, optimal inventory levels, timely stock replenishment, and seamless online order fulfillment.
q: li
Minimum 5 years of experience in warehouse operations or inventory management, with at least 2 years of team management experience.
li
Experience within the fashion or retail industry is strongly preferred, particularly in managing high-volume SKUs across multiple sizes and colours.
li
Strong knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory control, stock replenishment, and distribution processes.
li
Hands-on experience with inventory management systems, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), or ERP systems.
li
Experience in managing warehouse teams, operational budgets, and resources.
li
Familiarity with online order fulfillment and e-commerce warehouse operations.
li
Knowledge of GCC customs procedures and cross-border shipping would be an advantage.
li
Strong leadership, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
li
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced retail environment.
li
Proficiency in both Arabic and English.
r: li
Oversee day-to-day warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, picking, packing, stock transfers, and distribution.
li
Lead and manage warehouse personnel, including supervisors, tailors, and warehouse workers, ensuring operational efficiency and productivity.
li
Maintain optimal inventory levels to meet business requirements and customer demand.
li
Develop and implement warehouse policies, procedures, and operational processes to improve efficiency and accuracy.
li
Optimize warehouse layout, storage space allocation, and movement of goods to maximize space utilization and operational efficiency.
li
Manage inventory across a high volume of SKUs, including different product categories, sizes, and colours.
li
Ensure accurate inventory tracking, stock reconciliation, and timely updating of inventory records.
li
Oversee stock transfers, replenishment, receiving schedules, and loading and unloading activities.
li
Manage warehouse budgets and operational expenses, including labour, equipment, and maintenance costs.
li
Oversee online order fulfillment, ensuring accurate order processing, timely deliveries, and effective resolution of customer service issues.
li
Manage the tailoring team and coordinate garment production and alteration schedules to ensure timely completion.
li
Ensure compliance with warehouse health, safety, and security standards.
li
Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance warehouse productivity, inventory accuracy, and cost efficiency.
